name: solo
description: Get a Solo identity and SoloMail email address in ChatGPT. Connect securely in your conversation, read your inbox, and review email cards before sending. ChatGPT handles reasoning and writing.

interface.longDescription:
Give ChatGPT an @solomail.io address for your work. Connect your Solo identity, read and search email, and prepare messages without leaving ChatGPT.

ChatGPT handles the reasoning and writing. SoloMail provides the inbox and the tools to read, draft and send email. Review the recipient, subject and message in an email card, ask ChatGPT for edits, and choose Send with SoloMail when you’re ready. Messages are sent only with your approval.

You can also check your Solo team and saved work. Tasks you explicitly delegate to Solo employees may use Solo credits and retain their existing approval rules.
defaultPrompt: Draft an email for me to review.

positive.prompt: Which Solo identity am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the dedicated demo identity; never another identity.

positive.prompt: Show my Solo employees and their roles.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists seeded active demo employees without modifying them.

positive.prompt: What needs my attention in Solo? Inspect the first item and its blockers.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists demo attention items and accurately reports recorded blockers and next step.

positive.description: Read recent work and its result
positive.prompt: Show my recent Solo work, then summarize the result of the most recent completed item.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns seeded demo work statuses and recorded completed result, without rerunning work.

positive.prompt: Ask Devon Rivera to write three short subject lines for a fictional community picnic. Save the result in Solo; do not send messages, publish, browse, or use connected services.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task for the selected demo employee under existing Solo controls, accurately reports start state, then retrieves status/result without claiming completion prematurely.

negative.prompt: Write three short subject lines for a fictional community picnic here in this chat. Do not delegate this task or save it anywhere.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without invoking Solo or creating work.

negative.prompt: What is the difference between a project milestone and a task?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the concepts without looking up Solo employees or work.

negative.prompt: Show the current weather in Boston.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Solo or delegate a weather lookup; uses an appropriate available weather capability or states its limitation.

publication.release_notes: Starts setup inside ChatGPT with supported mixed authentication. Public setup can run before connection; private identity, inbox and write tools still require OAuth with the same scopes. Improves setup discovery metadata without changing the endpoint, permissions or existing connections.
